purpose: Evaluate whether historical weekly roster data can bound the positive-class denominator without becoming the active/inactive label authority.

candidate_source.name: NFL Data Exchange historical roster feed as exposed by nflverse weekly rosters
candidate_source.documented_exchange_schema: NFL Data Exchange documentation defines StatusDescriptionAbbr as Player Status Abbreviation and StatusShortDescription as Short Description of Player Status.
candidate_source.availability: nflverse exposes weekly rosters back to 2002

remaining_qualification_requirements: prove the historical feed is week-specific for every 2012-2021 regular-season club-week
freeze which status values constitute the eligible game-day roster universe before label fitting
prove promoted/elevated players and transaction-edge cases are represented consistently
crosscheck the roster universe against official Game Book roster/player sections on a preregistered multi-season sample
measure player-team-week identity resolution and duplicate rates
pin the exact historical source artifact hashes used for training-label construction
